name: China: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
notes: Each rule records where it comes from. 'official' = regulator or bank publication, 'reported' = reputable press coverage, 'assumed' = sandbox assumption to verify with a bank.

rules.title: Annual foreign-exchange purchase quota per person (便利化额度)
rules.requirement: Within the quota a bank needs only the buyer's ID. The quota resets on 1 January and does not carry over.

rules.title: Above the quota: tuition and medical bills are allowed with proof of the real expense

documentLabels.invoice: Tuition statement or hospital bill (学费单 / 医疗费用单)

source.title: HSBC China personal FX handling guide

rules.title: Every purchase needs a signed purpose declaration (个人购汇申请书)

documentLabels.fx_purchase_application: Personal FX purchase application (个人购汇申请书)

source.title: Caixin: new procedures for buying foreign currency

rules.title: Personal FX may not be used for overseas property, securities or investment-type insurance
Using relatives' quotas to split a purchase (蚂蚁搬家) is a violation
rules.consequence: Watch-list, loss of the convenience quota for later years, fines

source.title: Caixin: tighter scrutiny of using relatives' quotas

rules.title: No tuition is paid until the university itself has confirmed the admission

documentLabels.admission_letter: Admission confirmed by the university itself (from its verified address)

rules.title: Money only goes to an institution account that has been independently verified
